descriptions.shortDescription: CRM and sales pipeline management for Nextcloud.
descriptions.longDescription: Pipelinq is a CRM and sales pipeline management application for Nextcloud. It enables organisations to manage leads, contacts, opportunities, and sales processes within Nextcloud. Built on Open Register, it integrates with Nextcloud's ecosystem and provides a structured approach to managing customer relationships and sales workflows suitable for both government and commercial organisations.

Pipelinq is een CRM- en verkooppipelinebeheertoepassing voor Nextcloud. Het stelt organisaties in staat om leads, contacten, kansen en verkoopprocessen te beheren binnen Nextcloud. Gebouwd op Open Register integreert het met het Nextcloud-ecosysteem en biedt een gestructureerde aanpak voor het beheren van klantrelaties en verkoopworkflows, geschikt voor zowel overheids- als commerciële organisaties.

results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 5 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 7 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (290 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (3 authors), with 99% of the 290 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 4 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 2,164 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 2,242 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: Not measured: no issues were opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 11 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 33 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-10-08. Besides these, 742 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.

gate-57: CalendarSyncService::generateVEvent and PortalSessionManager::clearMfaPending are write capabilities with no caller
E2E: NcSelect dropdown options are unclickable inside NcDialog — body-appended menu renders beneath the modal
gate-61: four post-event listeners do writes and outbound AP HTTP inside the user's write (ADR-078)
Land the KCC contact-centre extension (8 schemas) against the unified `ticket` supertype
1038 of 1175 `@spec` anchors do not resolve, and gate-46 reports PASS over all of them
Decision needed: consume-or-remove the 7 dormant capabilities behind gate-6 and gate-57
navigation-ia spec describes a left-nav removed deliberately on 2026-07-03 — all 3 scenarios unsatisfiable
Sales overview date-range pills never render: manifest omits dateRange.control = "pills" that CnDashboardPage gates on
15 findAll() call sites pass register/schema at the top level of config, where OpenRegister ignores them — SLA, POS, attribution and segmentation query the wrong context
POST /api/segments cannot create any segment: "no schema mapping configured" for a contact schema that exists — and the message names one of four possible causes
winProbability is never served: the materialise:false lead calculation is absent from every object OpenRegister returns, so the Win % column and Deal widget render empty
7 more manifest include entries name visible:false schema properties (plus 1 phantom key) — the rest of the #775 class
IDOR: four #[NoAdminRequired] loyalty endpoints trust {accountId} from the URL — one of them drains another customer's points
mfaEnroll disables an already-verified second factor before any verification — MFA downgrade from a portal session
Attaching a POS customer with marketing consent overwrites the contact with a 10-key projection — every other field is nulled
POS payment webhook answers 200 for a delivery it never processed — the provider never retries and the payment is lost
Gift cards: redeem is not idempotent (a POS retry debits twice) and activate returns 200 for a blocked card

notes: Measured over the open issues and the issues closed in the last 90 days, in working days (Monday to Friday, Europe/Amsterdam, without Dutch public holidays).
Only the 200 most recently updated issues of each kind were read.

No issue carries a blocking label (such as blocker or critical), so every bug counts as an other bug.
